name: Meshtastic
description: Read from and write to a Meshtastic LoRa radio via the meshx HTTP+SSE daemon. Requires a running meshx daemon (https://github.com/retr0h/meshx). Lets the agent list radios, list mesh peers, read recent messages, send a message, and probe daemon health.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the meshx daemon (host:port). Defaults to the daemon's own default bind address.

defaultRadioId.description: Optional: radio_id to use when a tool call omits one. If null, tools require radio_id explicitly (unless exactly one radio is attached).

userAgent.description: User-Agent header sent with every request to the meshx daemon.
